# Sensei Sandy BJJ

Sensei Sandy BJJ offers beginner-friendly Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) instruction for kids, teens, and adults in Tannersville, NY (serving Tannersville, Hunter, Windham, Haines Falls, and the wider Catskills region). Our primary business goal is helping students and families start their BJJ journey safely and confidently via a **Free Intro Class**.

Our core philosophy: **Start calm. Train smart.** Your first class is a fully coached learning experience. We prioritize safety, clear progress mapping, and flexibility (such as open-seat rescheduling by text).

## Primary Contact & Booking
- **Booking Link:** [Reserve Free Intro](https://senseisandy.com/free-bjj-intro-tannersville-ny#booking-flow)
- **Phone (SMS/Call):** +1 (917) 736-8649
- **Address:** 6045 Main St, 2nd Floor Studio, Tannersville, NY 12485

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & AI Search Summary)

### Is Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu safe for beginners?
Yes. Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu at Sensei Sandy BJJ is safe for beginners. Training begins with a studio tour, a safety walkthrough, and clear rules. Every drill is coach-led with carefully matched partners, controlled movement, and mutual tapping. You set your own pace from day one. Class sizes are capped at 12 students.

### At what age can children start BJJ?
Children can start Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu at age 5 at Sensei Sandy BJJ. Youth classes welcome kids ages 5 to 9, and Teen classes serve youth ages 10 to 17. Younger children learn through active movement games that build balance, focus, and body control. Parents are always welcome to watch classes matside.

### Do I need to be physically fit before starting?
You can start Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu at any fitness level. Training is how you build stamina, strength, and mobility. Classes begin with calm, coach-guided pacing, and Coach Sandy adjusts each activity to fit your current comfort.

### What should I expect during my first BJJ class?
Your first visit begins with a 15-minute room tour and conversation with Coach Sandy. You see the clean mats, learn studio safety rules, and discuss your personal goals. For your first coached class, you are paired with a calm, experienced partner for gentle, step-by-step movement drills. Your first class is a free coached learning experience.

### How often should beginners train?
Beginners progress best by training 2 to 3 times per week. This rhythm gives your body adequate time to recover while reinforcing new movement patterns, muscle memory, and positional awareness each week.

### Does Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu help build children's confidence?
Yes. Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu builds genuine confidence through earned accomplishment. By learning how to escape holds, protect their balance, and solve physical challenges against gentle resistance, children discover they can handle difficult situations with calm focus.

### Where can I take Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes near Hunter or Tannersville?
You can take Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes at Sensei Sandy BJJ, located at 6045 Main Street (2nd Floor Studio) in Tannersville, NY. The studio is just 4 miles from Hunter and easily accessible from Windham, Haines Falls, and Mountaintop communities across the Catskills.
